sciencePOIs.name: Hab Alpha (Octavia E. Butler Landing)
sciencePOIs.description: Primary pressurized habitat & surface operations hub. Equipped with solar array, life support recharge, and MRO orbital comms relay.

sciencePOIs.name: Séítah Olivine Cumulate
sciencePOIs.description: Ancient magma chamber exposure altered by liquid water. High scientific value for planetary evolution and paleoclimate records.

sciencePOIs.name: Delta Front Solar Waystation
sciencePOIs.description: Autonomous solar & KILOPOWER micro-reactor charging pad + high-pressure O2/water refill kiosk at the base of the western delta.

sciencePOIs.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
sciencePOIs.description: Mars Sample Return backup depot. Contains 10 sealed igneous, sedimentary, and regolith cores ready for retrieval.

sciencePOIs.name: Kodiak Delta Remnant
sciencePOIs.description: Isolated butte preserving Gilbert-type delta foreset and topset beds—definitive proof of an ancient Jezero lake.

sciencePOIs.name: Hawksbill Gap (ISRU Water Clays)
sciencePOIs.description: Primary In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU) target. Hydrated clay strata suitable for thermal water extraction and propellant synthesis.

sciencePOIs.name: Belva Crater Rim
sciencePOIs.description: 800m impact crater exposing deep stratigraphy beneath the delta fan. Steep inner walls require tether or rover assist.

sciencePOIs.name: Belva Ridge Power & O2 Relay
sciencePOIs.description: Mid-crater autonomous rover/suit fast-charge depot and emergency pressurized storm pod.

sciencePOIs.name: Neretva Vallis Outflow (Bright Angel)
sciencePOIs.description: Ancient river valley that carved through Jezero's western rim. High potential for preserved biosignatures and subsurface ice.

sciencePOIs.name: Jezero Western Rim (Lookout Ridge)
sciencePOIs.description: Forward Emergency Shelter & High-Ground Comms Post (+634m above crater floor). Unobstructed line-of-sight for orbital relay.

hazardZones.name: Séítah Aeolian Sand Trap
hazardZones.description: Deep unconsolidated wind-blown ripples. High sinkage risk for weighted astronauts and wheeled carts.

hazardZones.name: Eastern Delta Scarp Cliff
hazardZones.description: Sheer 24°-28° fractured sandstone cliff face. Impassable on foot without climbing gear.

hazardZones.name: Belva Ejecta Boulder Field
hazardZones.description: Dense meter-scale ejecta blocks. High trip/suit-puncture hazard; slows EVA pace by 60%.

hazardZones.name: Margin Unit Loose Scree
hazardZones.description: Unstable carbonate talus slope. Avoid during heavy sample transport.

hazardZones.name: Western Rim Escarpment
hazardZones.description: Steep crater wall ascent (>22° slope). Requires switching to northern switchback corridor.
